headline: Santander allows back-office staff to count leave toward office attendance target
summary: Santander is permitting staff to log holiday and sick leave as days worked in the office to help meet a 12-day monthly in-person threshold, contrasting with stricter policies at competing lenders.
why: Banco Santander is one of the largest commercial banks in the eurozone.

impacts.name: Banco Santander
impacts.why: Workplace policies affect employee retention, administrative overhead, and workforce productivity.
